comment: The exact text every native host hands the model for a memcue search answer (#756). Read by conformance/render.test.mjs for the JavaScript renderer and by conformance/hermes_contract.py for the Python one of the Hermes provider, so the two cannot drift apart.

cases.name: two facts keep the id, the version, the scope and the content

facts.content: The build runs make test before the commit.

cases.expected:
f1@3 repo:example.com/app The build runs make test before the commit.
f2@1 global Facts are written in English.
2 facts

cases.name: a fact of an older binary prints no version

facts.content: An older binary prints no version.

cases.expected:
f1 An older binary prints no version.
1 fact

cases.name: a fact without a scope keeps id, version and content
cases.expected:
f1@2 A fact without a scope.
1 fact

cases.name: widening is named in the trailer and the hints stay word for word

hints: No facts of this repository, this host or global match; these come from other repositories: check that they apply.

cases.expected:
f1@1 repo:example.com/other A fact of another repository.
1 fact | widened | No facts of this repository, this host or global match; these come from other repositories: check that they apply.

cases.name: an empty answer keeps the wording of the CLI
an empty answer with a shelf hint names where the facts are

hints: 3 facts on the shelf match: -in shelf:research

cases.expected: No stored facts match. | 3 facts on the shelf match: -in shelf:research

cases.name: the language hint follows the facts in the trailer

hints: Facts use English by default; legacy facts may use other languages: search first in English; if English misses, retry in Russian or another legacy language.

cases.expected:
f1@1 global A fact.
1 fact | Facts use English by default; legacy facts may use other languages: search first in English; if English misses, retry in Russian or another legacy language.

cases.name: a fact served under the score floor says so
cases.expected:
f1@2 global A fact under the floor. (below the floor)
1 fact

cases.name: a long fact is clipped with an ellipsis
a fact never costs two lines
cases.expected:
f1@1 global first line second line
1 fact

cases.name: more facts than the bound are counted, not silently dropped
cases.expected:
f1@1 global One.
f2@1 global Two.
2 facts | … 2 facts not shown

cases.name: the character budget bounds the fact lines
cases.expected:
f1@1 global First fact.
1 fact | … 1 fact not shown

cases.name: entries that cannot name a fact are left out
an empty hint is not a line
cases.expected:
f1@1 global A fact.
1 fact | The real hint.
